what: The Mesen measurements of streambound-curve.json were taken on the generator in curve.provenance.generator. This record certifies they stand for the generator in finalGenerator: every record that ran Mesen was rebuilt on that tree, with no Mesen, by the sweep's own scene builder, and its project hash and ROM hash equal the recorded ones. A later generator-only change is certified by re-running test/lua/sw_rebuild_check.mjs; a change whose ROMs differ needs a re-sweep. (Re-made 2026-10-18 for Equipment (ROADMAP item 5) C6b, over the fresh re-sweep on the C6a tree, with the engine of the equipment commits and the harness that records sw_manifest_scene.mjs: recordedGenerator equals finalGenerator this time, because the sweep ran on the generator the tree has now and no generator-only change followed it, so the rebuild check is a plain confirmation that every record rebuilds to its recorded project and ROM; stage P, the probe, is part of it.)
